title: Nutty Nice American Date Galette
description: A sweet and spicy dessert featuring a glassy-jelly filling, wrapped in a flaky leaf pastry.
instructions: Combine flour, butter, icing sugar, and granulated sugar in a bowl, until crumbly.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, vanilla extract, almond extract, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper.
Pour the egg mixture into the flour mixture, and stir until a dough forms.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the rolled-out dough on a baking sheet, and cut out 12 equal-sized pieces.
Place a few dates in the center of each piece of dough, and fold the dough over the dates.
Place the galettes on a parchment-lined baking sheet, and brush the tops with unsalted milk.
Bake the galettes for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the galettes cool for 5 minutes, before serving.
Serve warm, with a drizzle of icing sugar if desired.
